context: Cleans up the CSV importer that reads a file and bulk-inserts its rows. `db.batchInsert` is callback-based and can fail on constraint violations.
explanation: Two bugs: (1) the `db.batchInsert` callback argument was dropped, so insertion errors are silently swallowed and `callback` is called with a success count even when the insert failed; (2) the stream `error` event handler was removed, so a read failure (missing file, permission denied) emits an unhandled error and crashes the process. Fix: restore the callback on `batchInsert` and the `error` handler on the stream.
